ktk.text: Silumgar, the snake-headed dragon, struck a pact with the Sultai after Tasigur offended the rakshasa, and Silumgar inherited their pacts.
Tasigur then betrayed the khans' meeting place to Silumgar's brood, and when Silumgar and Ojutai attacked, Khan Reyhan was killed and the khans fell.
Tasigur was rewarded by becoming Silumgar's slave and trophy of war, and the Sultai were utterly enslaved by the dragons, ending their identity as an independent clan.
Under Silumgar's rule, Sidisi was reduced to his undead slave and vizier, secretly fermenting poison to kill him, while Kotis led a brief rebellion from Kishla.

dtk.text: After Sarkhan saved Ugin in Tarkir's past, the Sultai no longer existed, and Silumgar and his clan supplanted them.
Silumgar's dragonlord discovered Sidisi's manipulation of translations and had her executed, then raised her as an intelligent undead servant.
Tasigur had offered his allegiance to the dragon and ended up as Silumgar's pet, displayed as a pendant.
Sidisi kept poisons in the hole where her heart had been, waiting to take back power, and with Silumgar weakened and Teval's aid the rebels defeated the dragonlord and took power.
